Jwt._comment: DEV-ONLY placeholder secret for this local-only project. Replace with a real secret (e.g. an environment variable / secrets manager value) before any non-local deployment.

Kafka._comment: Single-broker KRaft mode, matching the `kafka` service in the repo's docker-compose.yml. localhost:9092 is correct for the API running on the host (as it does today, before the API itself is dockerized) since that compose file publishes the broker's PLAINTEXT listener to the host at that port.

Resend._comment: PLACEHOLDER — no real API key is committed here. The real key is provided via `dotnet user-secrets set "Resend:ApiKey" "..."` in the InvoiceTracker.Api project (or an env var override, e.g. Resend__ApiKey, outside local dev) — never put a real key in this file. Until a key is configured, Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs falls back to NoOpEmailSender instead of throwing.
